nl.title: DirectAdmin gebruiken als reseller
nl.excerpt: Werken als DirectAdmin-reseller bij TripleZero iT: users, packages en escalatie naar support.
nl.bodyHtml:
TripleZero iT-resellers lossen first-line issues op in DirectAdmin; serverbeheer (CustomBuild, SNI) escaleer je via ticket.

Voorbereiding

  • Reseller credentials
  • Overzicht users

Stappen

  1. Log in op reseller-level
  2. Controleer List Users en usage
  3. Maak users alleen binnen contractlimieten
  4. Escaleer httpd/mailqueue/CustomBuild-problemen naar TripleZero iT

Controleren

  • Users zien eigen user-panel
  • Geen overselling buiten contract

Tip: Houd een runbook: zelf oplossen vs. escaleren.

Let op: CustomBuild is geen eindgebruikertaak.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: reseller; cant-login.

en.title: Use DirectAdmin as reseller
en.excerpt: Use DirectAdmin as reseller: steps in DirectAdmin for DirectAdmin, reseller.
en.bodyHtml:
For Use DirectAdmin as reseller follow a targeted checklist in DirectAdmin. Core themes: DirectAdmin, reseller.

Preparation

  • Access to DirectAdmin
  • Focus of this article: DirectAdmin, reseller
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Sign in to DirectAdmin. Filter or search for parts that belong to DirectAdmin, reseller.
  2. Select the correct domain/user account in DirectAdmin.
  3. Open the module that fits DirectAdmin (Email, DNS, File Manager, SSL, Cron Jobs, MySQL or Installatron).
  4. Note the current status, then apply only what “Use DirectAdmin as reseller” requires around reseller.
  5. Save and test outside DirectAdmin (browser, webmail, DNS lookup or cron log).
  6. Document what you changed around DirectAdmin, reseller (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for DirectAdmin, reseller matches “Use DirectAdmin as reseller”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside directadmin gebruiken als reseller
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get DirectAdmin, reseller right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if DirectAdmin, reseller touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: DirectAdmin, backups, tickets.
